en.html:
An explanation of this word to a person from the Middle Ages was not in the time available. Anyway, Muramasa probably knew the workings very well. Only the science-class name was missing.

The main keep would hardly be running on one generator only. Another supply would take over soon. The explosion had been larger than expected, and somewhere I could hear a collapse, but the entire castle falling down—no, that much cooperation I did not expect.

This trick had bought very little time. I had to spend it properly.

Footsteps and breathing told me where the encirclement had become disordered. I shoved Ichijou toward that side.

中世の人間にその単語の意味を説明している余裕は
無かった。
　おそらくこの<ruby>電磁操手<rt>ムラマサ</rt></ruby>は科学知識として知らぬだけ
で、その実質は<ruby>知悉<rt>ちしつ</rt></ruby>しているだろうけれども。

　本丸がたった一基の発電施設に頼っている筈はない。
すぐ別電源に切り替わる。
　思いのほか爆発は大きく、どこかで崩落の音も聞こ
えるが、まさかそれで城が倒壊するとも思えない。

　奇策で稼ぎ出した時間は決して多くなかった。
　それを、有効に使う。


　足踏みと呼吸の音で包囲陣の乱れた方角を察知。
　そちらへ、一条を押し飛ばす。

en.html:
I kicked off the floor and ran.
Straight ahead. Break through the center.

Not because of that rule about a small force attacking the enemy commander. Our monk-robed Kubo had already disappeared. Had the man recovered before everybody else and moved?

Where, and for what purpose, I did not know. Speculation could wait.

I fired the Gattari. Not enough for flight; that would deliver me directly into a pillar. Only enough to push my back and hurry the legs.

床を蹴り放って走り出す。
　向かう先は正面――中央突破。

　寡兵を以て衆を討つなら大将のみ狙う、その定法に
従ったのではない。
　敵将、かの僧形公方は既に姿が見えなかった。この
混乱のなか誰よりも早く平静を取り戻して動いたのか。

　その目的と行方は知れない。推量する時間もない。
　だが俺は合当理に火を入れた。騎航に足るほどでは
なく――柱にぶつかるだけだ――背中を押し出し足を
速める程度の出力で。

en.html:
Even at that output, the exhaust made a colossal racket inside the nighttime castle. I could feel it on my skin: the soldiers recovering from their confusion, all their attention turning to me.

Good. Let it come.

Now, provided Ichijou acted quickly and judged correctly, she should be able to escape.

Quick action she could supply in abundance. Correct judgment, let us not enter into that discussion.

My own life required looking after now.

　前者は充分に期待できる。
　後者はともかくとしても。

　ここから先は、自分自身の世話を焼かなくてはなら

I shot into it.

The route, I did not know. The ally who knew it was dead. Still I went on. Choose a direction. Keep going that way.

For merely getting outside, that should suffice. To insist on the original mission now—such stupidity would charge at least one life. And was Kuniuji even here tonight? That much also was unknown.

No... most likely he had been moved elsewhere. Why would the Koga Kubo not move him? However hard I fought, nothing remained here to win except my own safety—

考えても生命一個を最低限度の代価としよう。その上、

以外に勝ち取れるものはない――

I chewed on this most unwelcome fact.

Both were accomplished fighters. Probably the Rokuhara branch of Yagyuu Shinkage-ryuu. Two years earlier I had met a swordsman of that school and crossed blades with him. These two had very similar technique, and no less ability.

Cooperation, also, they were thoroughly qualified in. With all these facts assembled, a possibility came to mind.

ja.html: 景明（六波羅厩衆！）

en.html:
Not so much the shogunate as the Ashikaga family itself: that was whom they served. Guarding its members, doing the various jobs which must never see daylight.

People knew such a peculiar group existed. What it actually consisted of, nobody knew.

Still only a guess. But what was there against it? Silent, swift, a whole group moving as one; darkness for their bodies, only the swords showing. If these were not the Stable Corps, who the hell was qualified for that employment?

ja.html:
幕府というより足利一族に服従し、その身辺を守り、
また表にできぬ様々な職務に従事する。
　そんな特異な集団があることは知られていた。実態
まで知る者は、誰もいなかったが。

　推測でしかない。だが否定する材料もない。
　無音にして迅速、群れにして一個、闇に沈んで剣を
顕す――彼らがそうでないなら、一体何者がその厩衆
を務められるというのか。

en.html: That was almost wishful thinking. Suppose the shogunate kept several more groups like this? Bas karo. Let this at least be the last of them, or the weight in my heart would stop my legs.

ja.html:
それは願望に近い想いだった。
　こんな集団を幕府は他に幾つも抱えている――など
と思えば、心の重さで足が進まなくなる。

　せめてこれで打ち止めにして欲しいものだ。

en.html:
Many opponents, yes—but too far apart to work closely together. Seeing that, I chose: break through.

No crossing blades. Find the gaps and run through them.

ja.html:
数が多い――だが緊密な連携を取れる距離にない。
　そう見切って、俺は選択した。突破。

　剣を交えず、間隙を縫って突き進む。

en.html:
Every cut was sharp and powerful. Each one I dodged left my skin cold.

But once past, the advantage was mine. To strike me, they had stopped. I had not. Catching up would not be so simple.

太刀筋はどれも鋭く、<ruby>剛<rt>つよ</rt></ruby>い。
　一刀躱す毎に肌が冷える。

　だが切り抜けてしまえばこちらの物。
　斬りつけるため一度足を止めた彼らは、走り続けて
いる俺に容易くは追いつけない。

Put some distance between us here, and—

Jumped... no.

A mere jump could hardly have carried them past me.

Just now, that was—

　それで追い越されるとも思えない。

en.html:
I barely slipped beneath a thrust like violet lightning and swept my sword up in answer.

Not enough force to break the armor. But the attacker's own charge helped me out: away the warrior went, tumbling spectacularly along the corridor.

Mercifully, no procession of further enemies followed. I picked up the lost speed and ran down the slippery passage.

ja.html:
紫電めく刺突剣を危うくも掻い潜り、太刀をすくい
上げて一撃を見舞う。
　甲鉄を斬り破る威力は欠いた。だが突進を利用され
た格好で、その敵騎は派手に廊下を転がっていく。

　幸い、彼に続いて次々と敵が現れる事はなかった。
　鈍った速度を回復させ、滑り易い通路を駆ける。

en.html:
My saliva tasted bitter. I was beginning to suspect that I had taken everything rather too lightly.

Against opponents like these, attack Kuniuji Ashikaga—even just for show—and get away clean? Was that ever a possibility? From here, it looked like one idiot's magnificent daydream.

Aukaat se bahar. I had reached beyond my capacity.

The politics of a nation. History itself! Great men and heroes could attend to such matters. But no, Kageaki Minato also had to come and put his finger in the machinery.

ja.html:
唾が苦い。
　どうも、何もかも甘く見過ぎていたのではないかと
いう気がしてきていた。

　こんな者どもを向こうに回して、足利邦氏襲撃（形
だけではあるが）を行い、まんまと逃げおおせるなど
という真似が……果たして、可能であったのか？
　今となっては馬鹿の妄想としか思えない。

　身の丈に合わぬ事をした。
　そうも考える。

　国家の政治に――歴史に介入するなど。
　そんな一大事は偉人か英雄に任せておくべきだった。
何故、湊斗景明などがしゃしゃり出たのやら。

en.html:
Stairs in front of me. Decision made on the spot: I swept my sword across and brought them down.

Then—down to the floor below.

　太刀を薙ぎ払い、倒壊させた。

　そして――――下の階へ。

en.html:
If the enemy thought I had stubbornly gone upstairs after Kuniuji, this would buy considerable time. If someone was carefully watching with heat detection, the entire trick was useless. Still, trying cost nothing.

At least no pursuer had seen me do it. One breath, and I was running for the way out again.

ja.html:
あくまで邦氏を狙い上へ向かった――と、敵が誤解
してくれればここで大いに時間を稼げる。
　慎重に熱源探査を巡らせている者がいたなら、全て
無駄だが。やるだけやって損はなかった。

　少なくとも追っ手にこの場面を目撃されてはいない。
　俺は一つ息を吸い、脱出に向けてまた駆け出した。
